_provenance: Q14 defect-region corners (#192). Inputs are the phase-0 mutation suite's parents with one controlled defect injected, plus the coordinate-pass classes. `defects` is the merged, source-ordered output of segmentStatements + resolveStatements + resolveDocument + resolveSymbols over the input. Offsets are analyzed bytes, half-open, as contracted in src/explain/coordinates.ts.

corners.name: unbalanced-close-marks-the-stray-delimiter
corners.why: the injected `)` is the defect; the region is exactly that byte

corners.name: unterminated-string-spans-the-swallowed-run
corners.why: the region runs from the opening quote to end of input — the text the scan swallowed — not just the quote byte

corners.name: unclosed-bracket-marks-its-opener
corners.why: an unclosed delimiter's defect is AT THE OPENER: where it was supposed to close is exactly what is unknown, so the opener is the only honest location

corners.name: unclosed-brace-marks-its-opener
corners.why: same rule as the bracket; the note channel fuses these into one `unclosed:{` string with no offset at all

corners.name: bad-escape-marks-the-backslash
corners.why: symbols.ts is the only scanner that detects this class; the device errors at the escape and classes every later byte `none`

corners.name: bom-is-its-own-class-not-non-ascii
corners.why: U+FEFF is 3 UTF-8 bytes; in LEADING position it is a `bom` and is NOT also reported as `non-ascii`

corners.name: non-ascii-value-is-a-positional-fact
corners.why: examples.md example 22 — a legal command. The 4 UTF-8 bytes of the astral char are 4 analyzed bytes. isPositionalFact() must keep this out of error severity.

corners.name: non-ascii-runs-coalesce
corners.why: three adjacent 2-byte characters are ONE region, not three — a CJK comment must not produce one defect per code point

corners.name: clean-input-has-no-defects
corners.why: the floor: valid input carries no region at all
